pages.text: The $(bold)Redstone Torch$() is a power source — and an $(bold)inverter$(). On its own it's on. Power the block it's attached to and it turns $(italic)off$().$(br2)That flip — input on, output off — is a $(bold)NOT$() gate, the seed of all logic. $(italic)More Red$() sells one as a tidy block; see $(l:4_logic/gates)Logic$().
pages.title: The Inverter

pages.text: $(bold)Burnout.$() Pulse a torch too fast and it briefly burns out to stop runaway loops. Space your clocks, or use a $(l:4_logic/timing)Pulse Gate$() built for the job.
pages.title: Burnout
